keymap.title: Layers
keymap.help_base: What each key does normally. Click a key to change it.
keymap.help_fn: What each key does while Fn is held. Dimmed keys keep their firmware Fn function; locked keys are fixed by the firmware.
keymap.click_key: Click a key on the keyboard to see and change what it does.
keymap.reset_help: Set every key of a layer back to its factory function. Nothing is written until you apply.
